title: 口
teacherNotes: Release verified and merged L284 from origin/codex/l284-complete-package against latest origin/main. Dependencies are satisfied in playable order through L287; R001-R016 are already shipped.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: Release verified against production JSON through L284.
usageNotes: Approved display text and Stage 4 option text must stay inside the allowed boundary.
Do not introduce L285+ or other unlearned display characters.
The word 口子 should be illustrated as a slit-like tear, distinct from a large hole.
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for every sentence image.
Use L058 images only as illustration style anchors, not as character appearance references.
Use protagonist family continuity from L154/L162/L163 for the little girl and mother.
Every human prompt must explicitly name the role identity.
No visible text, letters, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brands, wall writing, or readable marks.
Final images must be WebP, compressed for mobile, longest edge no more than 1024px, target no more than 250 KB, hard limit no more than 400 KB.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate charAudio for 口 as public/assets/lessons/L284/audio/char-u53e3.m4a from the single character.
Generate G02 prefix audio from exact prefix text. Because the target character is final in the sentence, use the schema-supported no-suffix teachAudio format.
Generate G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-sentence audio from exact wrong text.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 遊樂器材隧道的洞口前被人堆了木頭，主角小女孩站在安全距離看著，因為洞口被擋住所以不能玩。畫面要清楚是遊戲場隧道洞口，不是山洞或危險工地；木頭和遊具不可有文字、數字、標籤或注音。
一件衣服的袖口或衣服邊緣裂開一個 V 字形或裂縫狀的口子，主角小女孩拿著衣服查看。這個口子不是圓形洞；要和 S03 的褲子大洞明顯不同。不可讓人物身體裸露；不可有文字、數字、標籤或注音。
一件褲子上破了一個明顯的大洞，洞可以是圓形或不規則形，主角小女孩拿著褲子查看。這是破洞，不是袖口裂縫；要和 S02 的 V 字形口子明顯不同。不可讓人物身體裸露；不可有文字、數字、標籤或注音。
餐桌上有看起來很可口的飯菜，主角小女孩和主角媽媽在桌邊準備吃飯。畫面重點是飯菜看起來好吃；不可有文字、數字、標籤或注音。
主角小女孩家裡有一大堆破舊積木，主角小女孩在旁邊整理或看著。積木可以看起來舊、掉色、缺角，但不要有尖銳危險；積木不可有字母、文字、數字、標籤或注音。

stage4Plan.reason: 「口子」是本課核心用法，目標字清楚。
